lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 28 — Paul Ashore on Malta / Arrival at Rome

questions.questionText: Once safely on shore, we found out that the island was called what?
How did the islanders treat them?
They built a fire and welcomed us all because it was raining and cold. Paul gathered a pile of brushwood. What fastened itself on his hand?
When the islanders saw the snake hanging from his hand they said he must be a murderer; Justice has not allowed him to live. What did Paul do?
options: He shook the snake off into the fire and suffered no ill effects

questions.questionText: The people expected him to swell up or suddenly fall dead. After a long time nothing unusual happened. They changed their minds and said he was a what?
I am the chief official of the island. My name is what?
Publius welcomed us to his home and showed us generous hospitality for how long?
Publius’s father was sick in bed, suffering from fever and dysentery. Who prayed and healed him?

When this happened, the rest of the sick on the island came and were cured. They honored us in many ways and when we were ready to sail they furnished us with the supplies we needed. After three months we put out to sea in a ship that had wintered in the island—it was an Alexandrian ship with the figurehead of the twin gods Castor and Pollux. We put in at Syracuse and stayed three days. From there we set sail and arrived at Rhegium. The next day the south wind came up, and on the following day we reached Puteoli. There we found some brothers and sisters who invited us to spend a week with them. And so we came to Rome. The brothers and sisters there had heard that we were coming, and they traveled as far as the Forum of Appius and the Three Taverns to meet us. At the sight of these people Paul thanked God and was encouraged. When we got to Rome, Paul was allowed to live by himself, with a soldier to guard him. How long did they stay on Malta before sailing?
The ship had the figurehead of which twin gods?
They put in at Syracuse then Rhegium then reached where?
Believers at Puteoli invited them to spend how long?
And so we came to where?
Brothers traveled as far as the Forum of Appius and where to meet them?
When Paul saw them he thanked God and was what?
In Rome Paul was allowed to live by himself with whom to guard him?

Three days later he called together the local Jewish leaders. He told them he was in chains for the hope of Israel though he had done nothing against our people or the customs. They said they had received no letters from Judea concerning him. They wanted to hear his views about this sect, which people everywhere speak against. They arranged to meet Paul on a certain day and came in even larger numbers to the place where he was staying. He witnessed to them from morning till evening, explaining about the kingdom of God, and from the Law of Moses and from the Prophets he tried to persuade them about Jesus. Some were convinced, but others would not believe. They disagreed among themselves and began to leave after Paul made this final statement from Isaiah. How many days after arriving did Paul call the Jewish leaders?
Paul said he was bound with this chain because of the hope of whom?
True or false: The Roman Jews said they had received no letters from Judea concerning Paul.
options: True — so they refused to meet

questions.questionText: They knew people everywhere were talking against this what?
Paul explained the kingdom of God and tried to persuade them about Jesus from which writings?
options: The Law of Moses and the Prophets

questions.questionText: True or false: Some were convinced by what he said, but others would not believe.

Paul quoted Isaiah about hearing but never understanding. He said God’s salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will listen. After he said this, the Jews left, arguing among themselves. For how long did Paul stay in his own rented house?
He welcomed all who came to see him. He proclaimed the kingdom of God and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ—with what?
I am chief official of Malta. Who am I?
True or false: Paul suffered no ill effects from the viper.
options: True — they still said Justice would kill him later

questions.questionText: Who built a fire because it was raining and cold?
The rest of the sick on the island came and were what?
True or false: The islanders furnished supplies when they sailed.
options: False — they charged a huge fee named

questions.questionText: They stayed three days at which city after leaving Malta?
They reached Rhegium then Puteoli then came to where?
True or false: Paul lived by himself with a soldier to guard him.
options: False — in a deep dungeon only
False — he was free to leave Italy

questions.questionText: Who traveled to the Forum of Appius and the Three Taverns?
Paul said God’s salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will _____.
True or false: Paul proclaimed the kingdom of God without hindrance for two years.
options: False — he was silenced at once
True — but he never taught about Jesus

questions.questionText: A viper fastened on my hand and I shook it into the fire. Who am I?
Publius had an estate nearby on which island?
Publius’s father suffered from fever and what?
Who placed his hands on Publius’s father after prayer?
True or false: Local Jewish leaders in Rome had heard of this sect spoken against everywhere.
options: False — they never heard of Jesus
False — they had letters condemning Paul already
